question: What is full name of the racer who ranked 1st in the 3rd qualifying race held in the Marina Bay Street Circuit in 2008?

final_sql: SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.buildUpPlaySpeed FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE ta.date = (SELECT MAX(ta2.date) FROM Team_Attributes ta2 WHERE ta2.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id) ORDER BY ta.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC, t.team_long_name ASC LIMIT 4

?
final_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN PA.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN PA.id ELSE NULL END)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN PA.ball_control ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN PA.id ELSE NULL END)) FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id

question: What percentage is Landon Donovan's overall rating higher than Jordan Bowery on 2013/7/12?
final_sql: SELECT ((ld.overall_rating - jb.overall_rating) * 100.0 / jb.overall_rating) AS percentage FROM Player p1 JOIN Player_Attributes ld ON p1.player_api_id = ld.player_api_id JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' JOIN Player_Attributes jb ON p2.player_api_id = jb.player_api_id WHERE p1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND ld.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00' AND jb.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00' LIMIT 1

question: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
final_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS L INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID

question: Provide the percentage increase in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013 for SME, LAM, and KAM respectively.
final_sql: SELECT c.Segment, ((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 AS PercentageIncrease FROM yearmonth AS y INNER JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND c.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY c.Segment ORDER BY CASE c.Segment WHEN 'SME' THEN 1 WHEN 'LAM' THEN 2 WHEN 'KAM' THEN 3 END

question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers, average score, and rank.
final_sql: SELECT T1.CharterNum, AVG(T2.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(T2.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS rank FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T1.CharterNum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.CharterNum ORDER BY avg_score DESC

question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.

question: What is the average writing score of each of the schools managed by Ricci Ulrich? List the schools and the corresponding average writing scores.

question: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id), CAST(SUM(T1.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T2.OwnerUserId FROM posts AS T2 GROUP BY T2.OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(T2.OwnerUserId) > 10 ) AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.OwnerUserId

question: For each year before year 1975, what was the average time in seconds of the champion of each race?
final_sql: SELECT r.year, AVG(CAST(substr(res.time,1,instr(res.time,':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(substr(substr(res.time,instr(res.time,':')+1),1,instr(substr(res.time,instr(res.time,':')+1),':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(substr(res.time,instr(res.time,':')+1),instr(substr(res.time,instr(res.time,':')+1),':')+1,2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time,'.')+1) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0) AS avg_time_seconds FROM races AS r INNER JOIN results AS res ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1 AND res.time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year

question: List down top 3 German drivers who has the shortest average pit stop duration and were born between 1980-1985.
final_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM drivers d JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 AND p.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY AVG(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which constructor scored most points from Monaco Grand Prix between 1980 and 2010? List the score, name and nationality of this team.
final_sql: SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS score FROM constructorResults AS cr INNER JOIN races AS r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId INNER JOIN constructors AS c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE ci.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1
